title.zh: 行动形成可供绑定的场景
title.en: Action forms scenes available for binding

claim.zh: 取得词库的解释律的实例：协调后的词库（coordinated 37）满足其条件——转移记录对二词编码成组，每个词形解析为其原子——故每个有限编码序列的解释是其原子的组合。指定空间关系与有支持的移动／命名史产生已有绑定构造的精确解释输入；另外有实际响应及访问、保留、时序失败见证。
claim.en: An instance of the interpretation law for acquired lexicons: The coordinated lexicon (coordinated 37) meets its conditions — its transition record groups the two-word encoding and each word form resolves to its atom — so every finite encoded sequence is interpreted as the assembly of its atoms. The specified spatial arrangement and supported movement/naming history produce the previous binding construction’s exact interpretation inputs; separate witnesses cover actual response and access, retention and timing failures.

hypotheses.zh: 给定整数二维位置、Manhattan 距离与范围2、三个已识别操作位置、移动规律、命名约定和安排。
hypotheses.en: Integer two-dimensional positions, Manhattan distance and range two, three identified operation sites, movement law, naming convention and schedule are supplied.

hypotheses.zh: 复用已取得分节与绑定架构；成功史有37单位声明支持，移动消耗5单位。
hypotheses.en: The acquired grouping/binding architecture is reused; the successful history has 37 declared support units, including five consumed by movement.

correspondence.zh: 接收位置与被命名位置是同一局部安排的关系角色。范围表示可取得性，未独自解释完整视野、注意、身体或沟通意图。
correspondence.en: Receiving and named positions are relational roles within one local arrangement. Range represents accessibility; it does not itself explain a full visual field, attention, bodies or communicative intention.

detail.zh: 空间接触史产生旧绑定构造的解释输入，直接调用其任意序列定理。
detail.en: The spatial history produces the prior construction’s interpretation inputs and directly invokes its all-sequence theorem.

output.zh: 给定取得绑定后，编码序列解释等于相应原子消息组合。
output.en: After the stated acquired bindings, encoded-sequence interpretation equals the corresponding atomic message assembly.

input.zh: 新移动史保留相同日志、候选范围、绑定记录与排除记录。
input.en: The movement history has the same log, repertoire, binding records and exclusions.

conditions.zh: 解释输入相同，不要求整个状态或支出历史相同；额外移动成本保留。
conditions.en: Interpretation inputs match; whole-state or expenditure-history identity is not assumed, and movement costs remain.

detail.zh: 位置和名称次数相同可因时序产生相反绑定；清楚视野漏掉所指可误学；访问无保留不形成绑定，支持不足阻断移动或执行。
detail.en: Matching positions and name counts can yield inverted bindings through timing; a clear view omitting the target can mislead; access without retention does not bind, and insufficient support prevents movement or response.

limitations.zh: 是给定安排下的新输入接通，不是移动安排自发形成、完整注意、知觉分类、意向理解或演化心理证明。
limitations.en: A new input composition under a supplied schedule, not a proof of schedule formation, complete attention, perceptual categories, intention understanding or evolutionary psychology.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 新查16项定理／29项声明审计，288项继承审计分列；作者反审和含未泛化结果的原始文献比较，无新实验或独立验收。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1: 16 new theorems / 29 declaration audits, with 288 inherited audits separately rebuilt; author counterreview and primary comparison including failed generalization, without a new experiment or independent acceptance.

next_delta.zh: 既有条件连接保留；下一重点是在匹配发育程序中识别已取得访问及所保留来源／次序如何进入实际使用，分别观察当前依赖与旧内容认可。原典已约束自动迁移，但未识别唯一机制或演化史。
next_delta.en: Preserve the completed conditional connections. Next identify how formed access and retained source/order information guide actual use in a matched developmental procedure, distinguishing present reliance from old-content endorsement. Primary evidence constrains automatic transfer without identifying a unique mechanism or evolutionary history.

history.en: 2026-10-08: computed accessible alternatives from actual movement and formally joined the checked binding interpretation; action-selection and category-formation premises remain.
